在于.en: The good thing about winter is that there are no mosquitos.

头部.pinyin: Tāng mǔ de tóu bù shòu le chóng chóng de yī jī
头部.en: Tom received a heavy blow on the head.
头部.es: Tom recibió un fuerte golpe en la cabeza.

头部.zh: 你要戴上头盔来保护你的头部。
头部.pinyin: Nǐ yào dài shang tóu kuī lái bǎo hù nǐ de tóu bù
头部.en: You have to wear a helmet to protect your head.

头骨.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。
头骨.pinyin: Jìn yī bù de jiǎn chá fā xiàn tóu gǔ shòu dào jù liè de zhuàng jī ér suì liè
头骨.en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.

头骨.zh: 仔细检查后发现，该头骨被重击碎裂。
头骨.pinyin: Zǐ xì jiǎn chá hòu fā xiàn gāi tóu gǔ bèi zhòng jī suì liè
头骨.en: After careful examination, it can be seen that the skull was smashed to pieces.

奸细.zh: 他认为我们当中有一个奸细。
奸细.pinyin: Tā rèn wéi wǒ men dāng zhōng yǒu yī ge jiān xi
奸细.en: He believes that there is a spy among us.
奸细.es: Él cree que hay un espía entre nosotros.

小行星.zh: 不要把流星和小行星搞混了。
小行星.pinyin: Bù yào bǎ liú xīng hé xiǎo xíng xīng gǎo hùn le
小行星.en: Don't mix up comets and asteroids.

小行星.zh: 进入地球大气层后，小行星分裂成了无数的小块。
小行星.pinyin: Jìn rù dì qiú dà qì céng hòu xiǎo xíng xīng fēn liè chéng le wú shù de xiǎo kuài
小行星.en: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.

庄.zh: 庄的派对像是个追悼会。
庄.pinyin: Zhuāng de pài duì xiàng shì gè zhuī dào huì
庄.en: Trang's party was like a wake.

异乡.zh: 在异乡生活，偶尔收到朋友的关怀让人倍感温暖。
异乡.pinyin: Zài yì xiāng shēng huó ǒu ěr shōu dào péng you de guān huái ràng rén bèi gǎn wēn nuǎn
异乡.en: As a stranger in a strange land, the sporadic solicitude from friends can be especially heart-warming.

悠闲.zh: 假期里，我度过了悠闲的日子。
悠闲.pinyin: Jià qī lǐ wǒ dù guò le yōu xián de rì zi
悠闲.en: I spent idle days during the vacation.
悠闲.es: Pasé días sin hacer nada en las vacaciones.

拦住.zh: 暴风雨过后，那条路被倒下来的树拦住了。
拦住.pinyin: Bào fēng yǔ guò hòu nà tiáo lù bèi dǎo xià lái de shù lán zhù le
拦住.en: After the storm, the road was blocked with fallen trees.

晶片.zh: 这家公司生产电脑晶片。
晶片.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī shēng chǎn diàn nǎo jīng piàn
晶片.es: Esta compañía fabrica chips para ordenadores.

晶片.pinyin: Tái wān shēng chǎn xiān jìn jīng piàn

暴涨.zh: 因为暴雨，河水暴涨漫过河岸。
暴涨.pinyin: Yīn wèi bào yǔ hé shuǐ bào zhǎng màn guò hé àn
暴涨.en: Due to the rainstorm, the river water surged over the river banks.

构.zh: 我构不到那罐番茄罐头。
构.pinyin: Wǒ gòu bù dào nà guàn fān qié guàn tou
构.en: I can't reach that can of tomatoes.
构.es: No puedo alcanzar esa lata de tomate.

柴门.zh: 柴门霍夫是世界语的创造者。
柴门.pinyin: Chái mén huò fū shì shì jiè yǔ de chuàng zào zhě
柴门.en: Zamenhof is the creator of Esperanto.
柴门.es: Zamenhof es el creador del esperanto.

柴门.zh: 世界语的创始人柴门霍夫是一个眼科医生。
柴门.pinyin: Shì jiè yǔ de chuàng shǐ rén chái mén huò fū shì yī ge yǎn kē yī shēng
柴门.en: Zamenhof, the creator of Esperanto, was an ophthalmologist.

沙乌地阿拉伯.zh: 沙乌地阿拉伯有非常丰富的石油。
沙乌地阿拉伯.pinyin: Shā wū dì ā lā bó yǒu fēi cháng fēng fù de shí yóu
沙乌地阿拉伯.en: Saudi Arabia is very rich in oil.
沙乌地阿拉伯.es: Arabia Saudita es muy rica en petróleo.

沙乌地阿拉伯.zh: 在沙乌地阿拉伯，女性不允许驾驶汽车。
沙乌地阿拉伯.pinyin: Zài shā wū dì ā lā bó nǚ xìng bù yǔn xǔ jià shǐ qì chē
沙乌地阿拉伯.en: Women are not permitted to drive cars in Saudi Arabia.
沙乌地阿拉伯.es: A las mujeres no se les permite manejar en Arabia Saudita.

煮蛋.zh: 当爸爸的必须至少会煮蛋。
煮蛋.pinyin: Dāng bà ba de bì xū zhì shǎo huì zhǔ dàn
煮蛋.en: Daddy must be able to cook at least one egg!

煮蛋.pinyin: Nǐ zǎo cān xiǎng chī shuǐ zhǔ dàn ma
煮蛋.en: Do you want a boiled egg for breakfast?

独行.zh: 赛义认为数学家自给自足的独行於一小块天堂。
独行.pinyin: Sài yì rèn wéi shù xué jiā zì jǐ zì zú de dú xíng yú yī xiǎo kuài tiān táng
独行.en: Saeb thinks mathematicians are self-contained walking pieces of heaven.

画龙点睛.zh: 我将增加画龙点睛的功能。
画龙点睛.pinyin: Wǒ jiāng zēng jiā huà lóng diǎn jīng de gōng néng

画龙点睛.zh: 画龙点睛是一则寓言故事。
画龙点睛.pinyin: Huà lóng diǎn jīng shì yī zé yù yán gù shi
画龙点睛.en: "Drawing dragons and dotting in the eyes" is a fable.

登机手续.zh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？
登机手续.pinyin: Lián hé háng kōng gōng sī bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù de guì tái zài nǎ lǐ
登机手续.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?

百分百.pinyin: Nǐ bǎi fēn bǎi zhèng què

直到现在.zh: 不，直到现在她都没有恋爱过。
直到现在.pinyin: Bù zhí dào xiàn zài tā dōu méi yǒu liàn ài guo
直到现在.en: No, until now she has never fallen in love.
直到现在.es: No, hasta ahora ella nunca se ha enamorado.

相左.zh: 我找跟您意见相左的人毫无困难。
相左.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo gēn nín yì jiàn xiāng zuǒ de rén háo wú kùn nan
相左.en: I have no difficulty finding people who disagree with you.

相左.zh: 那两个部门有时候意见相左。
相左.pinyin: Nà liǎng gè bù mén yǒu shí hou yì jiàn xiāng zuǒ
相左.en: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.

相符.zh: 他的意见和我们的相符。
相符.pinyin: Tā de yì jiàn hé wǒ men de xiāng fú
Cǐ rén yǔ miáo shù xiāng fú

相识.zh: 史密斯先生是她的一个相识。
相识.pinyin: Shǐ mì sī xiān sheng shì tā de yī ge xiāng shí
相识.en: Mr Smith is an acquaintance of hers.
相识.es: El Sr. Smith es un conocido de ella.

相识.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé wǒ xiāng shí hěn jiǔ le
相识.en: Tom and I have known each other for a long time.

简而言之.pinyin: Jiǎn ér yán zhī nǐ hèn wǒ shì ba
简而言之.en: In a word, you hate me, don't you?

简而言之.pinyin: Jiǎn ér yán zhī wǒ bù tóng yì
简而言之.en: To put it briefly, I do not agree.

纾解.zh: 一杯咖啡纾解了我的头痛。
纾解.pinyin: Yī bēi kā fēi shū jiě le wǒ de tóu tòng
纾解.en: A cup of coffee relieved me of my headache.
纾解.es: Una taza de café curó mi dolor de cabeza.

胶片.pinyin: Zhè gè xiàng jī lǐ méi yǒu jiāo piàn
胶片.en: There is no film in this camera.
胶片.es: No hay cinta en esta cámara.

胶片.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī juǎn cǎi sè jiāo piàn
胶片.en: One roll of color film, please.

蒜头.pinyin: Suàn tóu fā yá le zěn me bàn
蒜头.en: What should one do with germinating garlic bulbs?

表皮.zh: 你的嘴唇软绵绵的，就像仙人掌的表皮一样。
表皮.pinyin: Nǐ de zuǐ chún ruǎn mián mián de jiù xiàng xiān rén zhǎng de biǎo pí yī yàng
表皮.en: Your lips are soft like the surface of a cactus.
表皮.es: Tus labios son tan suaves como la superficie de un cactus.

表皮.zh: 昆虫有一层坚硬的表皮。
表皮.pinyin: Kūn chóng yǒu yī céng jiān yìng de biǎo pí

视察.zh: 干部们视察了我们的学校。
视察.pinyin: Gàn bù men shì chá le wǒ men de xué xiào

视察.zh: 韩国允许了国际原子能总署的视察。
视察.pinyin: Hán guó yǔn xǔ le guó jì yuán zǐ néng zǒng shǔ de shì chá
视察.en: Korea allowed an inspection by the IAEA.

起皱纹.zh: 若没有将衣服摺起来或是挂在衣架上，会起皱纹。
起皱纹.pinyin: Ruò méi yǒu jiāng yī fu zhé qǐ lai huò shì guà zài yī jià shàng huì qǐ zhòu wén
起皱纹.en: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
起皱纹.es: La ropa se arruga si no se dobla o se pone en una percha.

迎刃而解.zh: 在不久的将来这些问题都会迎刃而解。
迎刃而解.pinyin: Zài bù jiǔ de jiāng lái zhè xiē wèn tí dū huì yíng rèn ér jiě
迎刃而解.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
迎刃而解.es: Estos problemas se resolverán en un futuro próximo.

连结.pinyin: Zhè lǐ yǒu xiē yǒu qù de lián jié

连结.zh: 那只鹦鹉是托比亚斯与他已故父亲之间唯一的连结。
连结.pinyin: Nà zhī yīng wǔ shì tuō bǐ yà sī yǔ tā yǐ gù fù qīn zhī jiān wéi yī de lián jié
连结.en: That parrot was Tobias's only connection with his late father.

银座.pinyin: Tā zài yín zuò dā chéng le dì tiě
银座.en: She got on the subway at Ginza.

锄.pinyin: Huà chú wèi jiàn huà jiàn wèi chú
锄.en: Make the hoe your sword, and the sword your hoe.
锄.es: Hacé de tu azada tu espada y de tu espada tu azada.

阴雨.zh: 阴雨连绵的一周后，阳光让人感到一阵温暖喜悦。
阴雨.pinyin: Yīn yǔ lián mián de yī zhōu hòu yáng guāng ràng rén gǎn dào yī zhèn wēn nuǎn xǐ yuè
阴雨.en: Sunshine is a warm burst of joy after a gloomy, rainy week.

阴雨.pinyin: Tiān qì yī rán yīn yǔ

附.zh: 她把随附的支票寄给了我。
附.pinyin: Tā bǎ suí fù de zhī piào jì gěi le wǒ
附.en: She sent me the enclosed check.

附.zh: 一张卡片被附在了礼物上。
附.pinyin: Yī zhāng kǎ piàn bèi fù zài le lǐ wù shàng
附.en: A card was attached to the gift.

限定.zh: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。
限定.pinyin: Zài xiàn dìng shí jiān nèi wán chéng rèn wu shì yī ge zhí yuán de jī běn sù zhì
限定.en: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.

顶级.zh: 我的梦想是要成为一个顶级的麻将高手。
顶级.pinyin: Wǒ de mèng xiǎng shì yào chéng wéi yī ge dǐng jí de má jiàng gāo shǒu
顶级.en: My dream is to become a very strong mahjong player.

顶级.zh: 英格兰所有顶级球队都在英超联赛。
顶级.pinyin: Yīng gé lán suǒ yǒu dǐng jí qiú duì dōu zài yīng chāo lián sài
顶级.en: All the top teams in England are in the Premier League.

顺畅.zh: 这辆车没有以前跑得那么顺畅了。
顺畅.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē méi yǒu yǐ qián páo de nà me shùn chàng le
顺畅.en: This car is running less smoothly than it used to.

高架.zh: 里约热内卢的一条海边的高架自行车道倒塌了。
高架.pinyin: Lǐ yuē rè nèi lú de yī tiáo hǎi biān de gāo jià zì xíng chē dào dǎo tā le
高架.en: An elevated seaside bike path collapsed in Rio.

龄.zh: 一辆车龄八年的车子几乎是毫无价值的。
龄.pinyin: Yī liàng chē líng bā nián de chē zi jī hū shì háo wú jià zhí de
龄.en: An eight-year-old car is almost worthless.
龄.es: Un coche de ocho años casi no tiene valor.

上载.zh: 飞机上载有五百名乘客。
上载.pinyin: Fēi jī shàng zǎi yǒu wǔ bǎi míng chéng kè
上载.en: The plane had five hundred passengers on board.

世俗.zh: 生活从不会停止，但世俗生活却会。
世俗.pinyin: Shēng huó cóng bù huì tíng zhǐ dàn shì sú shēng huó què huì
世俗.en: Life never ends but earthly life does.
世俗.es: La vida no acaba nunca, pero la vida en la Tierra sí.

乔纳森.zh: 乔纳森吃牌了，因为与对方球员打架。
乔纳森.pinyin: Qiáo nà sēn chī pái le yīn wèi yǔ duì fāng qiú yuán dǎ jià
乔纳森.en: Jonathan was booked because he got into a fight with a player on the other team.

二百五.zh: 我校图书馆藏书二百五十万册。
二百五.pinyin: Wǒ jiào tú shū guǎn cáng shū èr bǎi wǔ shí wàn cè
二百五.en: My school library has a collection of 2.5 million books.
